title: Uniform provisions concerning the approval of motor cycles equipped with a positive-ignition engine with regard to the emission of gaseous pollutants by the engine (version 1.1.0, 01 series of amendments)
scope_summary: Approves vehicle types with regard to the limitation of gaseous pollutants (CO, HC, NOx) emitted from their positive-ignition engines, verified by a type-I urban driving cycle test and a type-II idle CO test. It applies to vehicles of categories L3, L4 and L5 (motorcycles, motorcycles with sidecar and motor tricycles) with positive-ignition engines.
scope_quote: This Regulation applies to the emission of gaseous pollutants from positive-ignition engines of vehicles of categories L3, L4 and L5.
applies_to_components: positive-ignition engine (four-stroke or two-stroke) of the vehicle
exhaust gas emissions of carbon monoxide, hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides
gearbox (as vehicle characteristic used in test)
relation_to_other_regulations: Vehicle categories L3, L4 and L5 as defined in Annex 7 to the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3), TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.1/Amend.2 as amended by Amend.4
Approval mark may be combined with marks of other Regulations annexed to the 1958 Agreement under which the vehicle is approved (para. 4.5)
Approval numbers begin with 01, corresponding to the 01 series of amendments in force since 31 May 1988

defined_terms.label: Approval of a vehicle
defined_terms.definition: The approval of a vehicle type with regard to the limitation of the emission of gaseous pollutants from the engine.

defined_terms.label: Vehicle type
defined_terms.definition: A category of power-driven vehicles which do not differ in essential respects such as the equivalent inertia determined from the reference weight and the engine and vehicle characteristics defined in Annex 1 items 1-6 and 8 and Annex 2.

defined_terms.label: Reference weight
defined_terms.definition: The weight of the vehicle in running order (total unladen weight with all tanks full) increased by a uniform figure of 75 kg.

defined_terms.label: Engine crank-case
defined_terms.definition: The spaces in or external to an engine which are connected to the oil sump by internal or external ducts through which gases and vapours can escape.

defined_terms.label: Gaseous pollutants
defined_terms.definition: Carbon monoxide, hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides, the last expressed in nitrogen dioxide (NO2) equivalent.

applicability_hints: This is a whole-vehicle emissions approval: engines, exhaust systems, catalysts, carburettors/fuel injection, ignition or 'additional anti-pollution devices' are not approved separately but fall under it as part of the vehicle type; changing them may constitute a modification of the vehicle type (para. 6) requiring retest or extension.
Only positive-ignition (spark-ignition, petrol/gasoline) engines are covered; compression-ignition engined L-category vehicles are outside scope.
Only categories L3, L4 and L5 are covered; mopeds (L1, L2) and quadricycles (L6/L7) are not within this scope.

A change of engine characteristics listed in Annex 1 items 1-6 and 8 (e.g. cycle, bore, stroke, cylinder capacity, anti-pollution devices) or of the reference weight/equivalent inertia class creates a different vehicle type.
Crank-case ventilation design is relevant since the engine crank-case is defined and its gases count as potential pollutant sources.
Two-stroke as well as four-stroke engines are covered.
Approval mark is affixed on the vehicle, close to or on the manufacturer's vertical data plate.
